cohort: 17 patients with complete septate uterus, double cervix, obstructed hemivagina, and ipsilateral renal agenesis admitted to the Third Xiangya Hospital of Central South University between June 2007 and December 2019
finding: Complete septate uterus with double cervix, obstructed hemivagina, and ipsilateral renal agenesis is a variant of obstructed hemivagina and ipsilateral renal agenesis syndrome.
